why_en: Rumi read every isiXhosa word on this page correctly: the title, the instruction and all 21 body-part labels. The only difference is in the printer's margin stamp, which a learner never sees: Rumi left out the print date and time. The PDF's text layer lists the labels in a scrambled order around the drawing, so the comparison ignores word order and counts only wrong, missing or extra words.
